# Sorting Algorithms

Here are some common sorting algorithms.

Quick sort average time complexity :: O(n log n) <!--anki:101-->
Quick sort worst-case time complexity :: O(n^2) <!--anki:102-->

## Merge Sort

Merge sort is a divide and conquer algorithm.

%% card start reverse=true %%
Describe Merge Sort

---

1. Divide array in half
2. Recursively sort each half
3. Merge the two sorted halves
%% card end id=201 %%

Merge sort space complexity ::: O(n) <!--anki:202-->
